Ownership probes close every newly acquired slot. Final native artifact passed all five synthetic lifecycle cases, installation, upgrade and portable regression.

remaining_limits: Unsigned publisher and no fresh second-device installation proof.
Run registration is not proof of execution after an actual Windows login; OS Startup Apps can disable it.
Launcher itself is not supervised; its loss closes its host until manual start or next login.
No automatic download, automatic live process replacement, backup/restore UI or WSL-record migration.
No real account login, mail send, physical phone delivery or general product acceptance established by these native tests.
